key_findings: All 120 valid attempts completed and received official grading; no provider failures, timeouts or integrity failures. Earlier outer-root provider-blocked attempts are excluded.

There are 26 documented final-answer grading disagreements, kept officially False: Terra nine native instances; Sol all 16 native failures plus smol invoice Q10. Every Sol native failure independently matches the requested option/value and deterministic workbook calculation.

Terra smol Q5, Q10, Usage Q3 and Q4 compute a correct result, then call final_answer with a wrong literal in the same executor call. Sol smol repairs most of these by observing a result before a later final-only call; Usage Q4 remains a wrong hardcoded 17.422 despite logged 17.237.

Terra smol voting Q25 obtains the correct district winner dictionary, but stock smolagents 1.23.0 nested generator evaluation corrupts the set union: CPython returns four non-winning parties; LocalPythonExecutor returns seven. The deterministic replay reproduces the trace. Sol’s set comprehension correctly returns four.

New native runs repair Luna’s sparse nine-ballot District lookup grouping, zero-based Q23 point mapping and overescaped league Q9 penalty regex. Complete DistrictCode mappings and literal marker counts match canonical calculations.

Correct scalar answers can hide coverage errors. Terra native 00 Usage Q3/Q4, stats-only Q1/Q4 and flow-only Q3 retain 8759 instead of 8760 observations; Terra flow-only Q4 further parses only 7292 records because its optional weekday regex accepts exactly three letters. Both-on recovers all 8760 observations, and Sol native Usage tasks use complete coverage.

Data evidence controls sample_stats availability; flow evidence adds independent metadata. Basic schema/sample scope information remains available with evidence off; profiling is collected identically in all native arms. Source Excel calendar-date normalization applies to every native arm.

One attempt per arm does not establish statistics causality or model-family ranking. Native separate sole Answer actions and the stock smol executor allow different answer-verification behavior; network sandboxes differ. No post-hoc normalization, rejudging, rescoring or quality retries were performed.
